business_summary: Mabpharm Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in research, development, production, and commercialization of drugs and biosimilar for cancers and autoimmune diseases in the People's Republic of China. It offers CMAB007, a recombinant humanized anti-immunoglobulin E monoclonal antibody for treatment of asthma patients; CMAB009, a recombinant anti-EGFR chimeric monoclonal antibody for the first-line treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer; and CMAB008, a recombinant anti-TNF-alpha chimeric monoclonal antibody for the treatment of ulcerative colitis in adults, ankylosing spondylitis, rheumatoid arthritis, Crohn's disease in adults and pediatric patients aged above 6 years old, fistula Crohn's disease, and psoriasis. The company also develops CMAB807/CMAB807X that has completed Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of osteoporosis, tumor bone metastasis, and giant-cell tumor of bone; CMAB819 that has completed Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of metastatic non-small cell lung cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, and head and neck squamous cell carcinomas; and CMAB015, a biosimilar candidate for secukinumab to treat psoriasis and ankylosing spondylitis that is in Phase I clinical trial. In addition, its products under the pre-clinical stage include CMAB017 for the treatment of advanced solid tumors; CMAB016, a biosimilar product candidate of dupilumab for the treatment of atopic dermatitis, asthma, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps, eosinophilic esophagitis, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and prurigo nodularis; CMAB022 for the treatment of inflammatory diseases; and CMAB023, a biosimilar drug candidate for Tezepelumab. Further, the company is involved in research and development, manufacturing, technical consulting, technology transfer, and technical services of biological products, chemical biological reagents, diagnostic reagents, and drugs. Mabpharm Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
business_summary_ko: 바이오제약 회사인 Mabpharm Limited는 중국에서 암 및 자가면역 질환에 대한 의약품 및 바이오시밀러의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 상업화에 종사하고 있습니다. 천식 환자 치료를 위한 재조합 인간화 항면역글로불린 E 단일클론 항체인 CMAB007을 제공합니다. 전이성 대장암의 1차 치료를 위한 재조합 항-EGFR 키메라 단일클론 항체인 CMAB009; 및 성인의 궤양성 대장염, 강직성 척추염, 류마티스 관절염, 성인의 크론병 및 6세 이상의 소아 환자의 크론병, 누공 크론병 및 건선의 치료를 위한 재조합 항-TNF-알파 키메라 단일클론 항체인 CMAB008. 이 회사는 또한 골다공증, 종양 뼈 전이 및 뼈 거대 세포 종양 치료에 대한 임상 3상 시험을 완료한 CMAB807/CMAB807X를 개발하고 있습니다. 전이성 비소세포폐암, 간세포암종, 두경부 편평세포암종 치료를 위한 임상 1상을 완료한 CMAB819; 및 건선 및 강직성 척추염 치료를 위한 세쿠키누맙의 바이오시밀러 후보물질인 CMAB015(Ph)
